title: A story's head
description: The JSON head of a story file in porelo-project's stories/: one function of value to a user, the test the person runs at its end, every issue it needs, and its state, moved as an issue's.

id.description: ST and a number without leading zero; the file is <id>.md or <id>-<words>.md.

title.description: The story's name, as its heading repeats it: one line, no leading or trailing space.

priority.description: How soon it is wanted, as Jira says it; within a state, the index lists the higher first.

gain.description: What a user gains, in one sentence.

test.description: The test the person runs at the story's end, in one sentence.

issues.description: Every issue the story needs, as <repository>#<number> as the repository's index writes it, a leading zero included, each once; none yet is an idea.

tested.description: The day the person ran the story's test and it held: set on a Finished story, null on any other.

state.description: Where the story stands, written and moved by the same hands as an issue's state.
